items.title: Mathematics has changed. Let's act like it
items.title_zh: 陶哲轩：数学已改变，学界须适应人工智能
items.title_en: Terence Tao: Mathematics Has Changed and Must Adapt to AI
items.summary: Terence Tao argues that AI has fundamentally changed mathematical research and the field should adapt its norms and practices accordingly.

items.title: The AI cost of JavaScript frameworks
items.title_zh: AI 时代 JavaScript 框架的成本之辩
items.title_en: The AI Cost of JavaScript Frameworks
items.summary: The article examines how AI coding agents alter the tradeoffs and hidden costs of using JavaScript frameworks, sparking a broader community debate about why frameworks exist and whom they serve.
